purpose: Maintain a judgment even for a supposedly exceptional case.
keywords: N / plain clause + といえども
Even children have opinions of their own.
Even a small amount must not be wasted.
formation: N / plain clause + といえども
restrictions: Often with たとえ or an authority/status noun.
mistake: It is concessive, not simply a quotation with 言う.
